metric: Total reported crimes against women (IPC/BNS + SLL)
mappingNotes: Pandhurna is grouped into Chhindwara, Maihar into Satna, and Mauganj into Rewa to match the available district boundary polygons.
Bhopal Commissionarate and Bhopal Rural are grouped into Bhopal; Indore Commissionarate and Indore Rural are grouped into Indore.
Railway and Cyber Crime Cell rows are excluded because they do not map to one district polygon.
District counts are raw reported totals, not population-adjusted rates.
